test_title: PYST 43: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Note: All numbers are single digit numbers only.)

(Left) € & % & 5 6 3 1 © 1 4 6 @ £ @ $ 8 8 £ 8 % 1 (Right)

 

How many such numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given series:

(Left) € & % & 5 6 3 1 © 1 4 6 @ £ @ $ 8 8 £ 8 % 1 (Right)

Condition to be checked:

**Symbol → Number → Symbol**

€ & % & 5 6 3 1 © 1 4 6 @ £ @ $ 8 8 __£ 8 %__ 1

There is one such number in the above arrangement (£ 8 %).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
